issues: The summary combines the command given in a dream (verse 2) with Lehi's later obedience (verse 3) as a single scene, compressing distinct moments.
The verse identifies the people Lehi addressed only as “them.” Identifying them as his sons or depicting Laman and Lemuel as present is not supported by this verse.
The verse says Lehi dwelt in a tent but does not specify whether he is inside or beside it.
The verse does not establish that Laman and Lemuel's refusal to heed Nephi and Nephi's prayer happened simultaneously; the visual inference should not combine them into one moment.
Scene lettering exceeds 65 words; split into smaller scenes
